text:
sophia: small onboarding snag - rerank smoke shows one vector with 1535 vs expected 1536 intermittently. looks like it happens during token refresh.
drew: can you share the server rejection log?
sophia: log: [2026-04-12T11:02:01Z] ERROR embeddings.api: bad_request expected=1536 got=1535 batch=onboard-19
li: that matches a bug i prototyped once: the batch helper requeue logic can drop a value when splitting a chunk on auth retry. off-by-one in the splice math.
drew: is the python sample app masking this?
sophia: yes, python pads short vectors silently in the sample which hides the failure for some users. very confusing.
li: short-term: SDKs and samples should validate shapes pre-send and fail fast. long-term: fix requeue logic and add unit tests simulating auth refresh mid-batch.
drew: propose SDK parity change: both node + python expose `strict_shape` default true. when true, reject mismatch with an explicit error object {expected, got, index}. when false, pad/trim but emit metric + warning.
sophia: can we hotfix samples to surface a 400 instead of silent pad? customers onboarding this week.
li: yes pushed small guard to the node helper and updated python sample to opt-in to padding. opened PR: https://git.internal/redwood/pull/8721
devex-bot: Created issue DE-1510: "embeddings: validate vector length before send; fix requeue on auth retry" (https://git.internal/redwood/issues/DE-1510)
ci-bot: Canary build for devex/helpers triggered (build 5150)
drew: also adding metric `sdk.embed.invalid_dim` with tag `sample_app=true|false` so support can see onboarding noise.
sophia: unit tests passing locally with auth-refresh simulation. will run the canary and update onboarding docs to document the strict behavior.
li: follow-up - add e2e smoke that runs against sampleapp to catch regressions.
sophia: thanks all, will close when docs + samples + canary green.
